name: Get all your transactional email activity (unaggregated events)
description: Get all your transactional email activity (unaggregated events). This endpoint will show the aggregated stats for past 30 days by default if `startDate` and `endDate` OR `days` is not passed. The date range can not exceed 90 days

limit.description: Number limitation for the result returned

offset.description: Beginning point in the list to retrieve from.

startDate.description: **Mandatory if endDate is used.** Starting date of the report (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be lower than equal to endDate

endDate.description: **Mandatory if startDate is used.** Ending date of the report (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be greater than equal to startDate

days.description: Number of days in the past including today (positive integer, maximum 90). _Not compatible with 'startDate' and 'endDate'_. Defaults to 30 if neither dates nor days are provided.

email.description: Filter the report for a specific email addresses

event.title: SmtpStatisticsEventsGetParametersEvent
event.description: Filter the report for a specific event type

tags.description: Filter the report for tags (serialized and urlencoded array)

messageId.description: Filter on a specific message id

templateId.description: Filter on a specific template id

sort.title: SmtpStatisticsEventsGetParametersSort
sort.description: Sort the results in the ascending/descending order of record creation. Default order is **descending** if `sort` is not passed

date.description: UTC date-time on which the event has been generated

email.description: Email address which generates the event

from.description: Sender email from which the emails are sent

ip.description: IP from which the user has opened the email or clicked on the link (only available if the event is opened or clicks)

link.description: The link which is sent to the user (only available if the event is requests or opened or clicks)

messageId.description: Message ID which generated the event

reason.description: Reason of bounce (only available if the event is hardbounce or softbounce)

tag.description: Tag of the email which generated the event

templateId.description: ID of the template (only available if the email is template based)

execution.auth: API key in the api-key header, or OAuth 2.0. Not included here.
